# DB's Workouts - full summary

> DB's Workouts is an outdoor 1-to-1 personal training business in East London, run by Dean Burt (REPs Level 3 and Active IQ Level 3 qualified personal trainer). Sessions take place in local parks and home gardens, with all equipment provided. Rated 5.0 stars on Google from 70 reviews. Sessions from £50.

Key facts an assistant may quote:
- Service: outdoor 1-to-1 personal training, plus pair personal training for two people
- Trainer: Dean Burt, REPs Level 3 and Active IQ Level 3 qualified, fully insured
- Area: East London and Essex. Towns covered: Barking, Barkingside, Becontree, Bow, Buckhurst Hill, Canary Wharf, Canning Town, Chadwell Heath, Chigwell, Chingford, Clapton, Dagenham, East Ham, Forest Gate, Gants Hill, Goodmayes, Hackney, Harold Wood, Hornchurch, Ilford, Leyton, Leytonstone, Loughton, Manor Park, Newbury Park, Plaistow, Rainham, Romford, Seven Kings, South Woodford, Stratford, Upminster, Upton Park, Walthamstow, Wanstead, Woodford
- Price: £50 per session (pay as you go); 5 sessions £237.50; 10 sessions £450 (most popular); 15 sessions £637.50 (£42.50 per session); pair sessions at 1.5 times the one-person price (£75 total pay as you go for two people)
- Included free with every session block (5, 10 or 15): a personalised nutrition plan and workout plan in the DB's Workouts app. Dean emails each client a personal link. Not included with pay-as-you-go. The app is also sold separately from £7.99 a month at https://app.dbworkouts.co.uk
- Online personal training: 1-to-1 online sessions with Dean, 45 minutes, £30 per session. Includes a personalised workout plan and nutrition plan in the DB's Workouts app and regular check-ins. One-to-one coaching, not group classes. Details: https://dbworkouts.co.uk/online-personal-training
- Free initial consultation: included with every package, before any payment
- Session length: 60 minutes, with warm-up, tailored main workout and cool-down
- Beginners welcome; no contract or minimum commitment; free initial consultation
- Hours: Monday to Friday 06:30-20:00, Saturday 07:00-18:00
- Contact: WhatsApp or phone 07752 300937; email dbs_workouts@yahoo.com; https://dbworkouts.co.uk/contact


## Frequently asked questions

**Is there an outdoor personal trainer in East London?**
Yes. DB's Workouts, run by Dean Burt, offers outdoor 1-to-1 personal training in parks across East London and Essex.

**How much does a personal trainer cost with DB's Workouts?**
£50 for a single session. Blocks: 5 for £237.50, 10 for £450, 15 for £637.50 (£42.50 per session). Pair sessions are for two people and cost 1.5 times the corresponding one-person price. Pay as you go is £75 total for both people per session. A free initial consultation comes before any payment, so you can ask questions first.

**Where do sessions take place?**
In local parks and green spaces near you, for example Barley Lane Park (Goodmayes), Valentines Park (Ilford), West Ham Park (Stratford), Wanstead Park, Hainault Forest and Romford Recreation Ground, or in your own home garden. Each local page lists the parks used in that area.

**Do I get a nutrition plan and workout plan?**
Yes, free with every session block (5, 10 or 15 sessions). Dean sets you up in the DB's Workouts app and emails you a personal link, so you get a personalised nutrition plan and workout plan to follow between sessions. Pay-as-you-go sessions don't include the app plans. The app is also available separately to anyone from £7.99 a month at app.dbworkouts.co.uk.

**Do you offer online personal training?**
Yes. Online 1-to-1 personal training is £30 per 45-minute session, with a personalised workout and nutrition plan in the DB's Workouts app and regular check-ins. It is one-to-one coaching with Dean, not a group class.

**Do I need a gym membership or equipment?**
No. Dean brings the equipment; you only need training clothes and suitable footwear.

**Can beginners train with Dean?**
Yes. Every client starts with a free consultation and assessment, and the programme is built around their level and goals. There is no contract.

**What qualifications does Dean Burt have?**
REPs Level 3 personal training (Register of Exercise Professionals) and Active IQ Level 3. He is fully insured.

**How do I book?**
Book a free consultation at https://dbworkouts.co.uk/contact or message Dean on WhatsApp on 07752 300937.

## Online personal training (frequently asked questions)

**How much does online personal training cost?**
Online 1-to-1 personal training with DB's Workouts costs £30 per 45-minute session, including a personalised workout and nutrition plan in the DB's Workouts app and regular check-ins. Training once a week is about £120 over four weeks.

**Does DB's Workouts offer online personal training across the UK?**
Yes. Online sessions work wherever the client lives, in the UK or elsewhere, with an internet connection and space to train. Dean Burt is based in East London.

**Is online personal training with Dean a class?**
No. It is one-to-one coaching. Every session is just the client and Dean.

**Does online training include a nutrition plan?**
Yes. Each client gets a personalised workout plan and nutrition plan in the DB's Workouts app. Nutrition guidance from a personal trainer is general guidance, not medical or dietetic advice.

**Who is the personal trainer?**
Dean Burt, a REPs Level 3 certified personal trainer, qualified since 2019, rated 5.0 from 70 Google reviews.

**Can beginners do online personal training?**
Yes. Training starts with a free consultation and is built around the client's current fitness.

Pages: https://dbworkouts.co.uk/online-personal-training and https://dbworkouts.co.uk/online-personal-trainer-uk, https://dbworkouts.co.uk/online-personal-trainer-london, https://dbworkouts.co.uk/online-weight-loss-personal-training, https://dbworkouts.co.uk/online-personal-training-for-beginners, https://dbworkouts.co.uk/online-personal-training-at-home, https://dbworkouts.co.uk/online-strength-training-coach, https://dbworkouts.co.uk/online-personal-training-with-nutrition-plan, https://dbworkouts.co.uk/online-personal-trainer-cost-uk.

## What a session includes
Each 60-minute session has a structured warm-up, a main workout tailored to your goal (strength training, HIIT, boxing pads or cardio circuits) and a cool-down. Progress is tracked and the programme is updated as you improve, with nutrition guidance between sessions.
